nodes.description: Mapping address => uint storing token balances of each holder.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint storing approved spending allowances.
Total token supply, initialized to 10000000 * 10 ** 18.
Token name string set to NugzCoin.
Token symbol string set to NUGZ.
Token decimals value set to 18.
Constructor that mints the entire totalSupply to the deployer (msg.sender).
Public view-like function returning balances[owner]; used internally as a check helper.
Public transfer function moving value tokens from msg.sender to 'to' after a balance check.
Public transferFrom function moving tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the allowance of msg.sender.
Public approve function setting allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for minting, balance checks, allowances and authorization.
Arithmetic in transfer: balances[to] += value and balances[msg.sender] -= value.
Arithmetic in transferFrom: balances[to] += value and balances[from] -= value.
Parameter 'owner' of balanceOf(address owner).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint value): recipient address.
Parameter 'value' of transfer(address to, uint value): amount transferred.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value): source address.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value): recipient address.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value): amount transferred.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint value): approved address.
Parameter 'value' of approve(address spender, uint value): approved amount.

edges.reason: balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the owner balance.
transfer reads and writes balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] to authorize the transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender].
constructor assigns totalSupply to the deployer balance.
constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from msg.sender.
transferFrom relies on msg.sender allowance, making authorization caller-dependent.
approve sets the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transfer calls balanceOf(msg.sender) inside its require check.
transferFrom calls balanceOf(from) inside its require check.
transfer executes the addition and subtraction on balances that may overflow or underflow.
transferFrom executes the addition and subtraction on balances that may overflow or underflow.
balanceOf uses its owner parameter to index the balances mapping.
transfer uses the to parameter as the recipient of the credit.
transfer uses the value parameter as the amount moved and checked against the balance.
the value parameter feeds the unchecked arithmetic operations on balances.
transferFrom uses the from parameter for the balance check and debit.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the recipient of the credit.
transferFrom uses the value parameter for the allowance/balance checks and the debit.
the value parameter feeds the arithmetic operations on balances.
approve uses the spender parameter as the allowance key.
approve uses the value parameter as the new allowance amount.
